field-filter.note: Field Filters on model fields with multi-value 'is' input and value suggestions; auto-mapped to blocks from the same dataset.

exclude-mode.note: Text and Number filters support 'is not' / 'not equal' with multiple values; quick filtering also has right-click Exclude.

scope-vs-filter.note: A block (widget) filter is pre-applied and not overridden by dashboard filters; the two are combined with AND.

compound-filter.note: Condition Group builds nested AND/OR, but only at report/exploration level; dashboard filters combine with AND only.

aggregate-filter.note: Right-click a metric value to add a greater/less-than condition; Field Filters can also be built from a metric.

text-search.note: Text filters offer contains/starts with/ends with; docs state all operators are case-insensitive. Field filters suggest values.

one-control-many.note: Each filter is mapped to chosen visualization blocks; mappings can be removed per block and reviewed in the Controls & filters panel.

cascading-options.note: Parent-Child Filter: a parent Field filter limits a child filter's suggested values (one direction only).

apply-button.note: Canvas dashboards wait for the viewer to click Apply by default; 'Auto-run on changes' turns instant re-run on.

selection-to-filter.note: Cross-filter clicks appear as blue filters in the filter panel and quick filters add local conditions; neither sets a filter control.

zoom-pan.note: Date Drill changes the time grain ('zoom in/out'); no visual zoom/pan or zoom slider on charts is documented.

legend-toggle.note: Viewers can hide/unhide items on a chart by clicking legend entries, without filtering other widgets.

single-select.note: Cross-filtering: click a data point to filter related widgets. Maps are not in its list of supported charts.

multi-select.note: Built-in charts cross-filter on one clicked point only; Shift-click multi-select is documented only for custom (Vega-Lite) charts.

tuple-select.note: Clicking one pivot/table cell passes all its dimensions (e.g. country+month) as a filter; selecting several cells is not documented.

range-brush.note: Only custom (Vega-Lite) charts can cross-filter with a dragged interval selection; built-in time charts have no brush.

numeric-brush.note: Interval (drag) selection cross-filter works only in custom charts, e.g. a custom Histogram; no built-in brush.

cross-highlight.note: Cross-filtering filters the target widgets; no highlight-share mode is described on the cross-filtering page.

two-selections.note: Docs say a new click replaces the previous cross-filter; whether clicks in two different charts stay ANDed is not stated.

selection-cohort.note: No feature to save a chart selection as a cohort and compare it with the rest; checked cross-filtering and drill docs.

fiscal-calendar.note: No fiscal-year start setting in date filters, drills or AQL time functions (calendar quarters/years only); needs a custom dimension.

as-of-anchor.note: Relative dates resolve against today/now; no option to anchor them to the latest data date is documented.

partial-period.note: No chart flag for incomplete periods; date filters only exclude the current incomplete period by default.

period-compare.note: Period Comparison (widget or dashboard control): previous period by any shift, e.g. 1 year for same period last year.

custom-compare.note: Period Comparison 'Custom period' compares the filtered base range with a chosen absolute range, aligned by first point.

to-date.note: AQL period_to_date (YTD/MTD/QTD) and trailing_period (trailing N months); date picker has ytd/mtd/wtd presets.

hierarchy-drill.note: Drill Down follows a dimension group order (e.g. continent>country>city); View Underlying Data shows rows. Breadcrumbs not described.

adhoc-breakdown.note: Right-click a chart (or Analyze toolbar) to Break Down a metric by any dimension; zero configuration.

underlying-records.note: View Underlying Data shows the detail rows behind a number; tables can be customized per metric.

drillthrough.note: Drill-through: right-click a point to open a target dashboard with clicked values passed into its filters.

metric-switch.note: A dashboard filter bound to a parameter field switches the measure via AQL (dynamic measure selection).

dimension-switch.note: Parameter fields enable dynamic dimension selection from a dashboard filter; viewers can also use Break Down.

sort.note: Viewers sort a table by any column via the column arrow, including multi-column sort order.

top-n.note: Top/Bottom N filters; charts have 'Group small values into Others' with a configurable number of groups shown.

pagination.note: Data Table and Pivot Table have a Pagination Size setting (rows per page).

pivot.note: Pivot Table plus point-and-click Percent of Total by row total, column total or grand total.

totals.note: Pivot Table toggles for row/column grand totals and sub-totals (row/column subtotals can't be toggled separately).

percent-of-total.note: Percent of Total (grand/row/column/custom total) in tables, pivots, line family; AQL of_all() for custom cases.

cumulative-moving.note: Running Total (Sum/Avg/Min/Max) in visualization settings; moving average via Moving Calculations or AQL window_avg.

index-100.note: Possible with an AQL metric dividing by first_value() over the time order; no one-click 'index to 100' option.

ranking.note: AQL rank()/dense_rank() with optional partition (e.g. within category or per pivot row).

bins.note: Histogram custom chart bins a measure with a max_bins option set by the builder; viewer-adjustable width not documented.

targets.note: Reference Lines add a constant goal or computed line to line/bar charts; Gauge chart shows progress toward a target.

what-if.note: Number-type parameter fields bound to a dashboard filter can feed a measure's AQL definition (analyst sets it up).

cohort-from-rank.note: AQL top()/ntile with dimensionalize() can define a rule-based cohort dimension (e.g. top customers by revenue).

cohort-retention.note: AQL Cohort Retention guide: cohort dimension + retention metric in a pivot heatmap; legacy Retention Heatmap chart too.

funnel.note: Conversion Funnel chart shows step-to-step conversion from measures; no reader step controls or conversion window.

parameter-presets.note: No named presets bundling several parameter/filter values for viewers; checked filters, parameter fields and URL params.

bookmarks.note: Filter and cross-filter state is kept in the URL (_fstate) and can be browser-bookmarked; no in-app named bookmarks.

url-state.note: Applied filters, controls and cross-filters are saved in the dashboard URL (_fstate); URL params can pre-fill controls.

reset.note: Controls & filters panel resets filters for the current tab, chosen tabs or whole dashboard; per-filter reset not described.

undo-redo.note: Undo/Redo covers drill-downs, break-downs and filter actions, with a history list on right-click.

saved-views.note: No per-user saved views of a shared dashboard; users can keep a bookmarked URL or build own dashboards in Personal Workspace.

refresh.note: Refresh button shows when the cached result was last updated; Refresh Now re-runs the query; cache duration is configurable.

date-filter.note: Date Filter covers all three: 'between' and other exact ranges, 'last N' periods, and Natural Time Expression phrases like 'last quarter'.

date-drill.note: Date Drill switches the grain for mapped widgets; drilling into only the clicked period is not documented.

trend-line.note: One-click trend line on line, column, bar, area and combination charts: linear, logarithmic, power, exponential or moving average, with Break down by legend and Merge into one line options.

custom-menu.note: Charts have a context menu (right-click since January 2026) with built-in actions such as Date-drill, Drill-through and View underlying data; custom charts choose which selections open it. Adding your own menu items is not documented.

range-filter.note: Number filters have between, greater than and less than, typed into boxes. There is no slider; a drag-to-select range needs a custom chart with an interval cross-filter.

row-actions.note: Go To URL actions on Data Table rows, with fixed or dynamic URLs built in AQL or SQL (for example concat() with a field), defined in the model for reuse. Data Tables only; Go To URL is the only action type.
